$comment: This repository owns how a component is drawn and described; the engine owns what it compiles. See gsim-core decision 0010. Keyed on the engine's component id, because 'passive.resistor' already is the name that decision means by 'this is a resistor' and a second display-kind vocabulary would be a second thing to drift. An entry here with no engine component is legal and expected: a component a front end must draw but no engine compiles. An engine component with no entry here is an error, because it would be placed from a palette with nothing to show. Edit this file to change a label, a category, help text or a symbol -- none of those are the engine's business.

control.counter.label: Counter
control.counter.description: Edge-triggered up/down counter with an optional modulus and reset.

control.delay.label: Delay
control.delay.description: One-simulation-step delay: reads its input's value from the previous step (general-simulator's own `prev:` reference).

control.discrete_state_space.label: Discrete State Space
control.discrete_state_space.description: Discrete-time linear state-space block x[k+1] = Ax[k] + Bu[k], y = Cx + Du.

control.discrete_transfer_function.label: Discrete Transfer Function
control.discrete_transfer_function.description: Discrete-time SISO transfer function num(z)/den(z) at a fixed sample period.

control.integrator.label: Integrator
control.integrator.description: Continuous-time integrator `dx/dt = u`, with optional output limits.

control.product.label: Product
control.product.description: Multiplies all of its input signals together.

control.saturation.label: Saturation
control.saturation.description: Saturates a signal between lower and upper limits.

control.state_space.label: State Space
control.state_space.description: Continuous-time linear state-space block dx/dt = Ax + Bu, y = Cx + Du.

control.sum.label: Sum
control.sum.description: Weighted summation. Number of inputs and their signs come from `signs`.

control.transfer_function.label: Transfer Function
control.transfer_function.description: Rational transfer function `H(s) = num(s) / den(s)`, realised as state-space.

control.transform.clarke_park_inv.label: Inverse Clarke-Park Transform
control.transform.clarke_park_inv.description: Combined inverse Clarke-Park (dq0 to abc) transform.

control.vco.label: VCO
control.vco.description: Voltage-controlled oscillator: maps the input signal onto a frequency ramp.

converter.phys2sig.label: Physical to Signal
converter.phys2sig.description: Reads a circuit node voltage or branch current back out as a signal.

converter.sig2phys.label: Signal to Physical
converter.sig2phys.description: Drives a physical-electrical node from a signal, as a voltage or a current.

extensibility.cscript.label: C Script
extensibility.cscript.description: Stateful block hosted in a precompiled C shared library.

extensibility.octblock.label: Octave Block
extensibility.octblock.description: Stateful block hosted in an Octave function.

extensibility.octfunc.label: Octave Function
extensibility.octfunc.description: Stateless block evaluated by an Octave function.

extensibility.pyblock.label: Python Block
extensibility.pyblock.description: Stateful block hosted in a Python module.

extensibility.pyfunc.label: Python Function
extensibility.pyfunc.description: Stateless block evaluated by a Python function.

hierarchy.inport.label: Inport
hierarchy.inport.description: Boundary inport — placed inside a subsystem body to define an input port on the parent-side block (spec §11). The `id` param is the port id; `kind` selects the signal domain.

hierarchy.outport.label: Outport
hierarchy.outport.description: Boundary outport — placed inside a subsystem body to define an output port on the parent-side block (spec §11). The `id` param is the port id; `kind` selects the signal domain.

ideal.diode.label: Ideal Diode
ideal.diode.description: Ideal diode: piecewise-conductance forward/reverse model with a breakdown branch.

ideal.switch.label: Ideal Switch
ideal.switch.description: Block-gated ideal switch: on/off conductance with a threshold and breakdown branch.

logic.flip_flop.label: Flip-Flop
logic.flip_flop.description: Edge-triggered flip-flop: D, T or JK, with an optional asynchronous reset.

logic.gate.label: Logic Gate
logic.gate.description: Boolean gate (and/or/xor/nand/nor/xnor/not) over its input signals.

logic.hysteresis.label: Hysteresis
logic.hysteresis.description: Schmitt-trigger hysteresis comparator with separate low and high thresholds.

logic.sr_latch.label: SR Latch
logic.sr_latch.description: Level-triggered set/reset latch with a configurable priority input.

machine.pmsm.label: PMSM
machine.pmsm.description: Permanent-magnet synchronous machine in the dq frame, with mechanical dynamics.

math.fn1.label: Math Function (unary)
math.fn1.description: Unary waveform-arithmetic function applied to one signal.

math.fn2.label: Math Function (binary)
math.fn2.description: Binary waveform-arithmetic function applied to two signals.

math.fn3.label: Math Function (ternary)
math.fn3.description: Ternary waveform-arithmetic function applied to three signals.

math.table_lookup.label: Table Lookup
math.table_lookup.description: Piecewise-linear lookup table over a list of [x, y] breakpoints.

passive.inductor.coupled.label: Coupled Inductors
passive.inductor.coupled.description: Coupled inductors (mutual inductance). SPICE element K.

passive.mutual_inductor.label: Mutual Inductor
passive.mutual_inductor.description: Magnetically coupled inductors with coupling coefficient k.

passive.transformer.label: Transformer
passive.transformer.description: Ideal transformer with turns ratio n.

power.pwm1.label: PWM Modulator
power.pwm1.description: Fixed-carrier PWM modulator with complementary output and dead time.

power.pwm2.label: Phase-Shift PWM Modulator
power.pwm2.description: Phase-shift PWM modulator driven by live frequency, phase and duty signals.

routing.from.label: From
routing.from.description: Receives a signal from a matching Goto tag.

routing.goto.label: Goto
routing.goto.description: Routes a signal by tag within local/scoped/global visibility.

signal.step.label: Step
signal.step.description: Step input — outputs `before` for t < t_step, `after` afterwards.

signal-flow.sink.scope.label: Scope (legacy spelling)
signal-flow.sink.scope.description: Signal scope sink, under the GSF v2 spelling `signal_flow.sink.scope`. Identical to Scope: both emit no netlist card at all. Kept so a sheet saved under this name still opens; place Scope on a new sheet.

signal-flow.source.step.label: Step (legacy spelling)
signal-flow.source.step.description: Step input, under the GSF v2 spelling `signal_flow.source.step`. Identical to Step: both compile to the same `kind=pulsewave` card. Kept so a sheet saved under this name still opens; place Step on a new sheet.

sinks.scope.label: Scope
sinks.scope.description: Captures the input signal for display in the waveform viewer.

source.current.dc.description: Ideal DC current source. SPICE element I.

source.current.exp.label: I (EXP)

source.current.sin.label: I (SIN)

source.dependent.vccs.label: VCCS

source.dependent.vcvs.label: VCVS
source.dependent.vcvs.description: Voltage-controlled voltage source. SPICE element E.

source.expwave.label: Exponential Wave Source
source.expwave.description: Exponential rise/fall signal source, using ngspice EXP() semantics.

source.pulsewave.label: Pulse Wave Source

source.sffmwave.label: SFFM Wave Source
source.sffmwave.description: Single-frequency FM signal source, using ngspice SFFM() semantics.

source.sinwave.label: Sine Wave Source
source.sinwave.description: Damped sine signal source, using ngspice SIN() semantics.

source.time.label: Simulation Time

source.voltage.dc.description: Ideal DC voltage source. SPICE element V.

source.voltage.exp.label: V (EXP)
source.voltage.exp.description: Exponential voltage source. SPICE element V with EXP waveform.

source.voltage.sffm.label: V (SFFM)
source.voltage.sffm.description: Single-frequency FM voltage source. SPICE element V with SFFM waveform.

source.voltage.sin.label: V (SIN)
source.voltage.sin.description: Sinusoidal voltage source. SPICE element V with SIN waveform.

source.file.label: File Source
source.file.description: A measured waveform read from a file: one output per value column, interpolated or held between samples.
